name: Eliminate redundant context decoding in streaming TTS

description: Eliminated redundant context re-decoding: context_decode_ms now 0ms (was ~1100ms). Frame gaps between batches still ~1400-1500ms due to batch decode latency.

asi.hypothesis: Track last_emitted_samples position to slice new audio directly instead of re-decoding context frames every batch
asi.result: context_decode_ms dropped from ~1100ms to 0ms - eliminated redundant work
asi.remaining_bottleneck: Batch decode takes ~1350ms which creates ~1400ms gaps. Next: try smaller batch size (1-2 frames) or parallel decoding, or reduce context_frames

name: Reduce batch_frames from 4 to 1 for lower decode latency
